planets.name: TOI-6038 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-6038 A with a 5.83-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-6038 A b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-6038 A. Its orbit and size follow Baliwal et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
